messages.subject: Testing Private/Protected Methods
parts: What's the standard approach for testing internal methods?  Is there anything to do besides create a derived class that exposes the method?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Testing Private/Protected Methods
parts:
For protected methods, you need to write mock extensions
to test them.

You don't need to test private methods. They're not part
of the public (or protected) API. They're "implementation
details". If you have independently testable functionality in private
methods, they should probably be made public or pulled out of
the class.

- Bob
